Head_BaseColor.png.description: Warm-neutral clean skin #BA9984; soft cheek/nose warmth, tired eye surrounds, muted perioral tone and restrained jaw stubble. No painted eyes or lips.

Head_Roughness.png.description: Restrained 0.59-0.66 roughness; nose/forehead slightly smoother than cheeks.

Zombie_Head_BaseColor.png.description: Optional muted, slightly sallow skin variant using the identical head UV. Injury/dirt remain separate RGBA decals.

Bruising_Decal_RGBA.png.description: Optional soft asymmetric bruise decal; alpha blend over clean skin, never multiply the whole face.

Dirt_Decal_RGBA.png.description: Optional restrained jaw/cheek dirt decal; alpha blend over clean skin, never multiply the whole face.

Jacket_BaseColor.png.description: Low-contrast woven fabric with sparse, curved tension folds; no baked lighting, panel seams or checker patches. Seam geometry belongs to the model.

Trousers_BaseColor.png.description: Low-contrast woven fabric with sparse, curved tension folds; no baked lighting, panel seams or checker patches. Seam geometry belongs to the model.

Shearling_BaseColor.png.description: Cream fleece with restrained 3-7 pixel crescent curl clusters, no large shaded lumps.

Boots_BaseColor.png.description: Brown worn leather with subdued flex creases; no baked laces, sole borders or mud.

Hair_BaseColor.png.description: Very dark brown-black with curved vertical growth streaks, grouped highlights, controlled warm/cool clump variation; use clump UV v along root-to-tip.

Hair_Roughness.png.description: Mostly matte 0.64-0.73 roughness, subtle clump variation to avoid plastic/wet hair.

uv_contracts.head_front: Frontal projection u=.5+x/.20; v=(z-1.53)/.28; meters. Eyes x=+/-0.035,z=1.683; mouth z=1.614. PNG rows are flipped to UV v. Do not apply localized face zones to a cylindrical UV unwrap.
uv_contracts.tile: Repeating local/world projection scale 2.5: one tile covers .4m; all details deliberately subtle because these are not garment-specific UV islands.
uv_contracts.hair_clump: Curved streaks run primarily along v; align each clump root-to-tip. A cap using another unwrap requires rotation/remapping.

resolution_decision: 1024 head/hair/clothing, 512 fleece/leather. No 2048 copies: the authored low-frequency detail contains no extra information at 2048.
limits: Maps are authored color cues, not scan-derived skin or baked anatomical lighting.
Material values are starting points; Blender lighting and render integration require visual QA.
Fold placement is generic tiling detail; garment-specific wear needs a dedicated unwrap.
Head frontal mapping can mirror face coloration onto a projected rear surface; assign a uniform skin material or separate back-of-head UV area where exposed.
Clean maps contain no bruises/dirt. Decals and zombie map are optional alternate layers.
